description:
[Deterministic GDPR Chapter V / Schrems II transfer audit. Pure statutory audit, read-only, side-effect free]. Evaluates international transfers of personal data outside the EEA under GDPR Articles 44-49, auditing adequacy decisions (including EU-US Data Privacy Framework), Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) requirements, and supplementary technical safeguards.
Usage: Use this tool to audit cross-border SaaS, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure/Hetzner), and vendor transfers under Schrems II.
Returns: JSON object with { isThirdCountryTransfer: boolean, destinationCountryCode: string, transferLawful: boolean, adequacyDecisionActive: boolean, transferMechanism: string, tiaRequired: boolean, supplementarySafeguardsStatus: object, riskScore: number, recommendations: array, legalCitation: string }.

dataSensitivityLevel.description: Classification level of transferred personal data

destinationCountryCode.description: 2-letter ISO country code of data recipient (e.g. US, CH, UK, IN, CN)

hasAdequacyDecision.description: Whether recipient country has an active adequacy decision under Art. 45

isEeaCountry.description: Whether destination is an EEA Member State

isUsRecipientDataPrivacyFrameworkCertifi.description: Whether US recipient is certified under EU-US Data Privacy Framework

supplementaryMeasuresImplemented.description: Whether technical safeguards (end-to-end encryption with EU sovereign key management) are enforced

transferImpactAssessmentCompleted.description: Whether a Transfer Impact Assessment (TIA) has been executed under Schrems II

transferMechanismUsed.description: Contractual transfer tool relied upon under Chapter V GDPR

name: gdpr_cross_border_transfer_audit
